name: push excess and relabel heights
mechanism: give each node a height and let nodes with excess flow push it downhill to neighbours with spare capacity; a node that cannot push raises its height; repeat until no node but the sink has excess

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Push–relabel algorithm' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Network theory: computes a maximum flow in a graph

requires: a node selection rule (highest label, FIFO: policy)
fails_when: excess may wander before draining; heuristics (gap, global relabel) matter in practice
